name: KDE Plasma & Desktop Control
description: Controls applications, notifications, clipboard, and desktop state in KDE Plasma over D-Bus/CLI.

tools.name: desktop_environment_info
tools.description: Inspect active display server (Wayland/X11), desktop session, and available KDE/D-Bus tools.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Display a desktop notification via org.freedesktop.Notifications (notify-send).

tools.name: launch_application
tools.description: Launch an installed desktop application by desktop entry ID (e.g. org.kde.dolphin).
